entries.1fe25b8be9be2c71: Planning, Development and Sales Channel Support
entries.5d11ba67038378dc: This is a business in which the non-consolidated subsidiary Chiiki Shōsha Kōchi Co., Ltd. conducts branding of local products and planning, development and sales channel support. It is not included in reportable segments, and ordinary income is not separately disclosed.
entries.64d2ef0556d1e3f2: A bank headquartered in Kochi City, Kochi Prefecture, providing financial services centered on banking, along with leasing and credit card businesses.
entries.984be3a00af5fd4b: This is a business in which consolidated subsidiary Kōchi Card Co., Ltd. conducts credit card and credit guarantee operations. Ordinary income from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is ¥386 million.
entries.b1f536fd860e4d1a: The core business of the Bank's group, conducted by the Bank at its head office and other branches, covering deposit, lending, securities investment and exchange operations. Consolidated subsidiary Kōgin Business Co., Ltd. conducts store security and other services, cash handling and merchandise sales, which are incidental to banking operations, and Kōgin Chiiki Kyōdō Tōshi Jigyō Yūgen Sekinin Kumiai conducts investment business. Ordinary income from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is ¥21,743 million.
entries.cd1dda6ec6b71242: This is a business in which consolidated subsidiary Ocean Lease Co., Ltd. conducts leasing and other operations. Ordinary income from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is ¥6,248 million.
